title: Ceviche with sweet potato and corn
steps: Peel and slice the sweet potato, boil it for 12 minutes and let it cool.
Cut very fresh (sushi-grade) fish into 1.5 cm cubes and salt them.
Slice the onion thinly, chop the chilli, mix both with the fish and lime juice and leave in the fridge for 10–15 minutes until the fish turns opaque.
Sprinkle with coriander and serve with the sweet potato, corn and lettuce.
